subject: Re-evaluating demo timing after internal sprint/travel commitments
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Philips <morgan.philips@nexerahealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-15 09:18 PDT
Subject: Intro + demo window (30 min) next week?

Hi Morgan —

Thanks for the quick chat yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a short 30-minute demo plan focused on latency, cost tradeoffs, and a quick peek at our Dashboard/rollouts. Attached is a one-pager with the proposed agenda.

Would next Tue/Wed (8/18 or 8/19) at 10:00–10:30 PT work on your side? If not, send a couple of windows that do and I’ll lock it in.

Also looping in Connor who can cover Dedicated deployment questions.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: Morgan Philips <morgan.philips@nexerahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nexerahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-17 11:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Intro + demo window (30 min) next week?

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the agenda. Unfortunately we just had a sprint replan and leadership pulled a pause on vendor demos that touch our LLM roadmap. Several engineering folks are traveling for a week starting 8/18 and the product team is reallocating headcount to a core analytics sprint through the end of Q3.

Given that, we need to close the demo window for now. I don’t want to ghost you — we’re still interested in inference economics and your dedicated offering, but timing is shifting. Could you hold a placeholder for Q4? Also please send the agenda + a short comparison doc (hosted vs dedicated) for my procurement folks.

—Morgan
Morgan Philips
Director, Product Strategy | Nexera Health
morgan.philips@nexerahealth.com

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17 14:42 PDT
Subject: Re: Intro + demo window (30 min) next week?

Hi Morgan —

Totally understand — thanks for the upfront note. I’ll mark the demo as deferred and add you to our Q4 waitlist so we can re-engage when your roadmap frees up.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll send a brief hosted vs dedicated comparison and the agenda to procurement today (attached SOW template for completeness).
- We’ll hold a tentative slot in early November and won’t send calendar invites until you give the go-ahead.
- If anything changes sooner — even a short 15-minute sync with engineering while folks are traveling — I’m happy to be flexible.

If it helps with internal prioritization, would your team prefer a short recorded demo + timestamped highlights instead of a live session? We can produce that this week.

Best,
Sofia
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-template.docx (stub)

Also, if procurement pushes for commercial flexibility (credits/short-term trial once they’re back), flag that here and I’ll take it up with RevOps. Keep the recorded demo option — that’s usually an easy way to stay top-of-mind without burning their calendar.
